purpose: Ask the Marshal for Crown troops
note: Issue 420, the-marshal.md section 2. Troops are a standing policy with two knobs, strength and posture; the monthly charge and who bears it are policy.md's. Placeholder prose and placeholder charges (section 10 tunes them). A reply's options cannot combine choices from two steps into one Order, so the knobs are offered as pairings; the effect takes any strength with any posture.

steps.prompt: What the Crown should send, and who bears it

options.label: a garrison to hold the towns, at 150 a month
options.text: Send a garrison to hold the towns. The Crown will bear the charge of it, 150 a month{insert:warmth}.

options.label: a force to patrol the country, at 350 a month
options.text: Send a force to patrol the country and meet whatever comes before it reaches a town. The Crown will bear the charge, 350 a month.

options.label: an army to put down the rebellion, at 700 a month
options.text: Send an army and put down the rebellion. Nothing else here will fight them, and I will not pretend otherwise. The Crown will bear the charge, 700 a month.

options.label: a garrison, and nothing from the Crown for it
options.text: Send a garrison to hold the towns. I trust the Crown's own interest is payment enough.
